## Description

Parameterizes rough Heston stochastic volatility models using Neural SDEs coupled with jump-diffusion processes to calibrate intra-day option implied volatility smile surfaces.

## Where it may fit

Short-dated options trading, implied volatility smile mispricing, volatility derivatives arbitrage.

## Vehicles

Volatility Arbitrage Funds, Options Market Making Desks.

## Required data

Intraday option chain quotes, implied volatility surfaces, underlying spot prices.

## Caveats

Requires specialized GPU solvers for neural SDE path simulation and adjoint sensitivity calibration.
